【原视频简介】
You can now run one of the best AI animation models on CPU with no VRAM at all, or on ultra-low VRAM cards.

It’s NVIDIA’s Kimodo — the new C++ port (kimodo.cpp) makes it fully local and much more accessible. No heavy Python + CUDA stack required.

Repo: https://github.com/localai-org/kimodo.cpp

In this video I show how to install it, which skeletons actually work (Soma / G1), native GLB export, retargeting to Mixamo, and the path into Unreal Engine.
—
🏆 Explore the Best 3D AI Tools on 👉 https://top3d.ai
